thread:
zoe li: Starting a cautious rollout for model v4q2-int4 -> 8% traffic. Shadow tests looked fine but small bump in hallucination score.
ben hart: Can you share per-cohort deltas? interested in longform and multi-turn recency slices.
zoe li: longform MRR -1.3, multi-turn recency -0.4, short q&a +0.5. Overall weighted MRR -0.45. hallucination precision -0.6 pts.
ravi: Product: is -0.45 within our soft limit? also curious about p95 latency.
ben hart: p95 improved by ~40ms, p99 unchanged.
triage-bot: Preflight checks: model binary checksum ok, eval suite ran (smoke + safety).
zoe li: Proposed gate rules: 1) quiet-burn 8% for 3h 2) if weighted MRR drop >0.5 sustained 1h -> fallback 3) if any slice drop >1.0 or hallucination +0.8 abs -> immediate targeted rollback 4) require A/B p-value >=0.1 to auto-promote further.
ben hart: Suggest lowering slice threshold for 'longform' to 0.7 (more sensitive). Also add late-joiner sampling to detect cold-cache regressions.
zoe li: Good catch. Adding longform_slice_threshold=0.7; late_joiner_sample=2x for first 30m.
oncall: Which metrics will PagerDuty monitor? exact names please.
ravi: Use metrics: "rollout.mrr.weighted_1h_delta" and "rollout.eval.hallucination_1h_delta"; alert if thresholds crossed for 15m.
zoe li: Launching quiet-burn now. Will post dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/promotes/4967890123
triage-bot: Promote job started by zoe li at 4967890123. Canary pods: v4q2-canary-01..02
ben hart: 45m update: synthetic eval shows weighted MRR -0.52 (just over), longform hallucination +0.9 (exceeds longform threshold). I'm patching a route override to send longform back to v4fp-qa and pausing promotion.
zoe li: Applying override now. Pausing next step and notifying support & oncall.
oncall: Subscribed to alerts. Will escalate if any user reports come in.
ravi: We'll re-run targeted ablation on longform prompts and check cachestate. If re-run clears, consider reintroducing with smaller step.
zoe li: Agree. Documenting decision in the ticket and scheduling a deep eval run.
